provenance.translation: Direct translation of the public Japanese guide. Proper names use the paired game localization dictionary; original guide sources remain in its metadata.

stageName.text: J-03 Branch, Floor 3: Castle of Slumbering Neighbors

lead.text: Build SP and E.G.O resources in Wave 1, then defeat all enemies within 4 turns in each of Waves 2–4. Rather than Clashing against every attack, use fast Blunt attacks to Stagger enemies and stop their remaining actions. The deadline causes a forced defeat that HP cannot withstand.

listLead.text: Prepare SP and resources in the first Wave, then clear each later Wave within 4 turns. Exploit weaknesses to Stagger enemies first and cancel multiple actions together.

statNote.text: A 4-Wave battle on Floor 3 of the Canto II dungeon. All 4 enemy types fought directly are Lv. 15 with 41 HP. Miner Slaves are also Lv. 15 here, unlike the Lv. 14 versions encountered earlier. Progress by clearing each Wave rather than attacking Baba Yaga's main body.

skillNote.text: The 2 Neighbor types share skills, as do the 2 Miner Slave types, giving 12 entries separated by user. Slicing Smack's +1 Skill Power On Use is not included in its displayed Base Power. Foot Stomp and Beak Smash use Minus Coins.

priorities.0.text: Wave 1 has no time limit. Raise SP through Clashes against its 3 enemies and collect resources for the E.G.O you plan to use before advancing.

priorities.1.text: Clear each of Waves 2–4 within 4 turns. At the start of that Wave's fifth turn, Baba Yaga’s Coming! reaches 0 and forces defeat.

priorities.2.text: Every enemy is weak to Blunt and has a Stagger Threshold at 50% HP. Use fast attacks to Stagger them and stop their remaining actions. Multi-target Blunt E.G.O is also effective.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: My team was wiped out despite having HP remaining

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: At 0 Baba Yaga’s Coming!, deployed units die and the fight ends in defeat. Healing or defense cannot extend the time limit. Watch the remaining counter in each Wave and keep attacking.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: There are too many enemy actions to Clash against them all

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Staggering an enemy before it acts also stops its later actions. Use a fast Blunt attack, then direct other actions toward remaining enemies instead of wasting them on other slots of an enemy that will be stopped.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: The last enemy became tough despite clearing the others

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Shuddering Terror grants Protection based on how many of the enemy's allies died during the Wave. If possible, defeat multiple enemies in the same turn; use strong attacks against weaknesses to finish survivors.

units.0.notes.0.text: 2 in Wave 1, 2 in Wave 2, and 2 in Wave 3. Parts cannot be broken.

units.0.notes.1.text: ×2 Blunt and ×2 Wrath resistance. Gains Protection when allies die, so reassess survivors after reducing enemy numbers.

units.1.notes.0.text: 1 in Wave 1, 2 in Wave 2, and 1 in Wave 3. Shares stats and skills with Slumber-broken Neighbor.

units.1.notes.1.text: From Wave 2 onward, gains 4 Baba Yaga’s Coming! at the start of each Wave.

units.2.notes.0.text: 2 in Wave 3 and 2 in Wave 4. In this boss fight, Lv. 15 with 41 HP, unlike the earlier Lv. 14, 40 HP version.

units.2.notes.1.text: ×2 Blunt and ×2 Sloth resistance. Ice Chuck has a maximum Power of 12, so do not let it through unopposed as if it were a weak normal enemy's attack.

units.3.notes.0.text: 3 in Wave 4. Shares stats and skills with Freezing Miner Slave.

units.3.notes.1.text: Parts cannot be broken. From Wave 2 onward, all enemies in each Wave must be defeated within 4 turns.

phases.0.title.text: Prepare while there is no time limit

phases.0.steps.0.text: 2 Slumber-broken Neighbors and 1 Rearisen Neighbor. The 4-turn limit does not apply here.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Raise SP through winning Clashes and prepare resources for later multi-target Blunt E.G.O. There is no need to take unnecessary hits to stockpile resources, but avoid rushing ahead with low SP.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Defeating all enemies advances to the next Wave. Later Waves have deadlines, so check HP, SP, and available skills before finishing this one.

phases.1.title.text: Stagger enemies before they act to stop multiple actions

phases.1.steps.0.text: 2 of each Neighbor type. All enemies receive 4 Baba Yaga’s Coming!, decreasing each turn.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Every enemy has ×2 Blunt resistance and a Stagger Threshold at 50% HP. Stagger them with fast Blunt attacks to stop their remaining actions. Check that the attacker will move before the enemy.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Defeat all enemies before the start of this Wave's fifth turn. Burn or other damage at the end of turn 4 can still finish them in time, but do not rely solely on uncertain damage over time.

phases.2.title.text: Reduce enemy actions with multi-target Blunt attacks

phases.2.steps.0.text: 2 Slumber-broken Neighbors, 1 Rearisen Neighbor, and 2 Freezing Miner Slaves. The countdown starts at 4 again when this Wave begins.

phases.2.steps.1.text: If available, use multi-target Blunt E.G.O such as Representation Emitter or Land of Illusion to Stagger or defeat several enemies. Check Attack Weight and actual targets; do not assume every enemy will be hit.

phases.2.steps.2.text: The slaves' Ice Chuck reaches 12 Power. Rather than losing with a weak skill, Stagger them first or block with a strong Clash. More enemy deaths grant Protection to survivors, so also aim for multiple kills in the same turn.

phases.3.title.text: Finish the last enemies with Sloth and Blunt

phases.3.steps.0.text: 2 Freezing Miner Slaves and 3 Shivering Miner Slaves. All have ×2 Blunt and ×2 Sloth resistance. Use remaining skills and E.G.O to clear them before the deadline.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Bind from Beak Smash can prevent early attacks next turn. Take necessary Clashes and quickly finish Staggered enemies.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Suppressing all 4 Waves ends the fight. At 0, Baba Yaga’s Coming! causes forced defeat rather than a normal high-damage attack; remaining HP cannot keep you alive.

skills.0.response.text: A Slash attack with a maximum Power of 8. A Blunt attack that Staggers it first also stops its later actions. Check that the intended attacker acts first.

skills.1.response.text: A Slash attack with a maximum Power of 8. A Blunt attack that Staggers it first also stops its later actions. Check that the intended attacker acts first.

skills.2.effects.0.text: [On Use] Take 10 damage. Gain +1 Skill Power.

skills.2.response.text: Its unmodified 2–6 range gains +1 Power On Use. The 10 self-damage still occurs if you win the Clash, but do not assume self-damage will reliably kill it.

skills.3.effects.0.text: [On Use] Take 10 damage. Gain +1 Skill Power.

skills.3.response.text: Its unmodified 2–6 range gains +1 Power On Use. The 10 self-damage still occurs if you win the Clash, but do not assume self-damage will reliably kill it.

skills.4.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn.

skills.4.response.text: A Minus Coin skill with Base Power 11 and Coin Power −9. A Heads hit inflicts 1 Fragile next turn. Use the current prediction to Clash or Stagger it first rather than looking only at the lower end of its range.

skills.5.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn.

skills.5.response.text: A Minus Coin skill with Base Power 11 and Coin Power −9. A Heads hit inflicts 1 Fragile next turn. Use the current prediction to Clash or Stagger it first rather than looking only at the lower end of its range.

skills.6.response.text: A Pierce attack with a maximum Power of 8. With the deadline in mind, exploit weaknesses to Stagger enemies rather than only assigning a separate Clash to every attack.

skills.7.response.text: A Pierce attack with a maximum Power of 8. With the deadline in mind, exploit weaknesses to Stagger enemies rather than only assigning a separate Clash to every attack.

skills.8.response.text: A 1-Coin skill with a maximum Power of 12. Stop it with a strong Clash or an earlier Stagger instead of facing it with a weak skill. Blunt attacks and multi-target Blunt E.G.O are effective against its user's weakness.

skills.9.response.text: A 1-Coin skill with a maximum Power of 12. Stop it with a strong Clash or an earlier Stagger instead of facing it with a weak skill. Blunt attacks and multi-target Blunt E.G.O are effective against its user's weakness.

skills.10.effects.0.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bind next turn.

skills.10.response.text: Base Power 4, Coin Power −1, and 2 Coins. Coin 2 inflicts 1 Bind next turn on hit. Take necessary Clashes so reduced Speed does not prevent you from Staggering enemies first next turn.

skills.11.effects.0.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bind next turn.

skills.11.response.text: Base Power 4, Coin Power −1, and 2 Coins. Coin 2 inflicts 1 Bind next turn on hit. Take necessary Clashes so reduced Speed does not prevent you from Staggering enemies first next turn.

passives.0.condition.text: An ally dies during this Wave

passives.0.effect.text: Gain Protection equal to the number of allies who died during this Wave (max 5).

passives.0.response.text: Taking too long to defeat enemies one by one makes survivors tougher. Use multiple kills in the same turn or strong attacks against weaknesses to finish within 4 turns.

mechanics.0.effect.text: At the start of Waves 2–4, grant 4 to all enemies. Decreases by 1 as each turn passes. If it reaches 0 at the start of that Wave's fifth turn, all deployed units die, forcing defeat. Backup and support units are excluded from this instant death, but cannot prevent defeat.

mechanics.0.response.text: Finish each Wave within 4 turns. The effect is absent in Wave 1, so use that time to prepare SP and resources.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Enemies fought directly have Stagger Thresholds at 50% HP. Staggering one stops its remaining actions.

mechanics.1.response.text: Instead of assigning a separate Clash to every enemy action, use 1 fast Blunt attack to Stagger an enemy and stop several actions.

warnings.0.text: The limit is 4 turns for each of Waves 2–4, not 4 turns for the entire fight.

warnings.1.text: Wave 1 has no limit, but from Wave 2 onward, healing and defense alone will not advance the fight.

warnings.2.text: The deadline causes instant death and forced defeat. Even a large amount of remaining HP cannot withstand it.

warnings.3.text: Survivors gain Protection based on the number of their allies who died. Retain enough damage to finish the final enemy.

warnings.4.text: Miner Slaves in this encounter are Lv. 15 with 41 HP. Do not use the earlier Lv. 14, 40 HP stats.

preparation.0.text: Deploy 5 Sinners. Use the dungeon's recommended Lv. 15 as a guide and prepare SP and resources in Wave 1.

preparation.1.text: All enemies are weak to Blunt. Wrath and Pride also work against Neighbors; Sloth works against the slaves. Pierce resistance is ×0.75, making a Pierce-only team less effective.

preparation.2.text: Check available multi-target Blunt E.G.O and its resource and SP costs. Without it, you can still progress by repeatedly using fast Blunt attacks to Stagger enemies and defeat them individually.

roles.0.reason.text: Stagger enemies before they act to reduce the action-count disadvantage.

roles.1.reason.text: Stagger or defeat multiple enemies together to help clear each Wave before the deadline.

roles.2.reason.text: Defeat the final enemy with Protection before the deadline.
